privacy.title: Privacy policy
points: The Olive Lot stores your account, fields, records and photos you upload.
Photos and field data are visible only to people who can access that field.
We do not sell your data.
You can request access or deletion at hello@The Olive Lot.com.

terms.title: Terms of use
points: The Olive Lot is in alpha. Features and limits may change.
You are responsible for what you record and who you invite to your field.
Do not share your account. If you lose access, contact us.
Using the service means you accept these terms.
